adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds an unconditional refresh call (`fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token"...)`) and a subsequent `prisma.credential.update(...)` before returning a new `jsforce.Connection`, with no check for whether the existing access token is still valid/expired. This means each call to construct/get the client will always hit the refresh endpoint and write to the DB, which is a concrete, diff-grounded efficiency/architecture issue and can plausibly increase contention/race potential, but isn’t a strictly verifiable correctness failure from the diff alone.
